xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF for #3737 bound remedy: call-shape ghx selection, spawn-failure fallback, named binary+status diagnostics. No --version health probe.

plan.title: BLOCKER: bug(scm): resolveBinary prefers ghx on presence alone, so a broken ghx silently kills triage, ingest, cache and pr:watch

narratives.Description: Bind call-shape selection so ghx serves only single-path GET; flag-rich GET and writes go to live gh. Fallback on real spawn failure of the invoked argv. Name the binary and status class. Do not add a --version probe.
narratives.Overview: Bound contract from critic 5470431912, successor lean 5470455877, verified-claims 5470459107, synthesis 5470462173. Do not build a health probe. Call-shape selection, spawn-failure fallback, named binary+status diagnostics.

items.title: Call-shape selection: ghx only for single-path GET

narrative.Acceptance: When both ghx and gh are on PATH, a mutation or a flag-rich GET never routes to ghx; a single positional path GET may still take ghx.

items.title: Fallback on real spawn failure of the invoked argv

narrative.Acceptance: Fallback triggers on real spawn failure of the invoked command, proven by a test that simulates a spawn failure rather than an unhealthy probe. No --version-style health probe is introduced.

items.title: Failures name the binary and the status class

narrative.Acceptance: A failure names the binary that was invoked and reports the status class including 0xC0000142 STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED; a test asserts the diagnostic content without reproducing the loader fault.
CHANGELOG [Unreleased] records the call-shape routing and named diagnostics and names #3737.

references.title: Issue #3737: resolveBinary prefers ghx on presence alone

intended_placement.cohesion_exemption: CHANGELOG.md is a chronological append-only release log. content/scm/github.md is the user-facing ghx surface rule that must match the runtime selection. Remaining files are existing resolveBinary spawn sites switched onto call-shape resolution.

acceptance.derived_reason: derived 4 independently testable clauses from the bound synthesis before product edit (#3323)

clauses.text: ghx is selected per call shape; a mutation or a flag-rich GET never routes to it.
Fallback triggers on real spawn failure of the invoked command, proven by a test that simulates a spawn failure rather than an unhealthy probe.
A failure names the binary and the status class; a test asserts the diagnostic content.
